title: Rhythm Action Sword Dance Combo
summary: Vertical gameplay promo prompt for a rhythm-action sword-dance combo, emphasizing input timing, hand-pose readability, hit beats, and style-meter feedback.
prompt:
Create a 15 second vertical gameplay promo for a mobile rhythm-action sword-dance combat system. The performer is a stylized playable hero, not a beauty subject. Prioritize input timing, hand-pose readability, combo anticipation, and HUD feedback.

0-3s: Extreme close-up on the hero's focused eyes and hands as the opening stance begins. Show four rhythm input markers approaching the timing line. Camera pushes in slowly, stable 9:16 framing, clean facial light, no glamor language.

3-6s: Hands sweep from cheeks to chest, then into a sharp sword-dance guard. Each gesture triggers a small hit-spark, controller/touch timing pulse, and combo count increase: 01, 02, 03.

6-10s: Pull back to waist-up gameplay framing. A translucent enemy silhouette telegraphs an incoming strike; the hero parries on-beat with a blue timing flash and short hitstop.

10-13s: The player chains a perfect-input flourish. Show STYLE S, stamina cost, cooldown ring, and safe color-coded feedback for accessibility.

13-15s: Final pose freezes for a reward beat. The combat HUD remains readable: combo score, timing grade, ability cooldown, and replay prompt.
